verdict.rationale: The only evidence of recurring scheduling is one community comment mentioning Render's "$1/mo crons". First-party Workflows SDK docs cover defining tasks and triggering runs from code, which is one-off triggering rather than a recurring schedule, so they don't count toward this story. missing for 10: first-party documentation of cron jobs or scheduled workflows (syntax, frequency, configuration), evidence that scheduling works via Blueprint, CLI, API or MCP, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
